content:
If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast exceeds true value by >2%, reduce forecast by 1–3% for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment is 1.00 and forecast is below true value by >1%, increase forecast by 0.5–2% for early horizon.

If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust downward by 0.3–0.8% for mid horizon if true value is rising.

If sentiment is 0.33 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon if true value is falling.
